market_vendor_barks: Fresh pretzels, still warm, get 'em quick!
Pie by the slice, pie by the pound, hon!
Peaches so ripe they'll sing to you!
Hot links, cold drinks, no waiting!
Fudge samples for anybody with a smile!
Lemonade squeezed while you watch, folks!
Rye bread, still steaming, step right up!
Two tacos, one coin, zero regrets!
Coffee strong enough to wake the pigeons!
Mustard on everything, that's the law here!
Buy a pie, get a wink for free, hon!
burying_ground_tour_captions: Lanterns flicker here, but nobody's home.
Shh. The stones like it quiet after dark.
That chill? Just the harbor breeze. Probably.
Old gates creak like they're telling jokes.
A tiny glow drifts by, then giggles away.
Fog rolls in to hide the tour's best secrets.
Legend says the ivy hums on foggy nights.
Watch your step. The shadows play tag here.
The moon checks in every night at midnight.
Tour over! The ghosts wave goodbye. Maybe.
rash_field_crowd_lines: Kick it! Kick it! Kick it high!
That's a goal, hon! Did you see it?
Volleyball by the water, best life!
Run, kid, run! You got this!
Best seat on the whole field!
Wave! We're on the big screen!
octagon_announcer_lines: Ladies and gents, welcome to the Wing Cage!
Hot sauce loaded, napkins ready, EAT!
Ten wings down and the sauce is flowing!
Pete's slowing down! Is this an upset?!
Crowd is roaring, keep those jaws moving!
Last plate! Last plate! Finish strong!
WINNER! A new champion of the Wing Cage!
Pete takes it! Better luck next round!
Defeat! Wipe your face and try again!
pete_eatoff_taunts: You chew like a sleepy turtle!
I warm up with more wings than that!
Need a bib, rookie? Or a nap?
My grandma eats faster than you!
Sauce too spicy for you, champ?
I eat plates for dessert, kid!
Go home and practice on crackers!
